text:
Jules Rivera: Quick dev check-in on the routing policy editor preview. Noticed two UX oddities during sim playback: priority numbers jump when you drag a rule across a collapsed group, and the validation toast appears behind the preview modal.
Priya Nair: I saw that too. For the priority glitch, I think the UI is re-computing the index on render while the animation is running. Could fix by computing the final index at drag-start and animating to that slot.
Tom B.: Re validation toasts, we currently mount them in the global layer but the preview modal uses a higher z-index. Simple fix is to portal to the modal or increase toast z. But I worry about toasts trapping focus when modal is open.
Lydia (a11y): If we portal to the modal we must ensure toasts are aria-live polite and don't steal focus. Also the color contrast on the inline validation pill in compact mode is 2.8:1 on small text. Needs at least 4.5:1 for body text.
Priya Nair: For animations I propose: 1) calculate target slot at drag start, 2) disable reflow-based index updates during drag, 3) show a stable ghost slot with a label like "Moving to position 3".
Jules Rivera: Love the ghost slot label idea. Also can we show the priority number on the ghost? Right now users only see it after drop.
Tom B.: Showing priority on the ghost is doable. We should also debounced-update the side-preview (sim results) so it doesn't re-run the entire simulation on every micro-move. Maybe 300ms debounce.
Lydia (a11y): Keyboard drag needs an announcement pattern. Suggest controls: when rule gains drag-focus, announce "Drag mode on. Use arrow keys to move. Press space to drop." Then each move: "Moved to position X between 'Auth' and 'Rate limit'" via aria-live.
Priya Nair: One more thing: validation messages on drop are terse: "Rule invalid". Can we expand to actionable copy: "Rule invalid: missing match condition. Click to edit or press 'E' to open rule editor." Keep it short but clickable.
Jules Rivera: Agree. UX note: include a small inline help icon next to validation text that opens the failing condition in context (deep link into the rule panel).
Tom B.: Dev note: deep links need stable rule IDs. Current ephemeral IDs from the client break on list reorders. We'll persist a client-surface id in the model layer.
ux-bot: Reminder: design sync Friday 9am PT. Agenda: ghost-slot affordance, toast layering, keyboard announcements, validation copy. Please drop short screen recordings in the doc beforehand. :spiral_calendar: 
Lydia (a11y): I'll run a quick checklist: focus persistence, aria-live messaging, contrast numbers for ghost label and validation pill, and keyboard help text examples. Will upload a sample script.
Jules Rivera: Thanks — putting a short prototype together now, will post a 10s gif in the doc when ready.
